reason: A browser plugin that detaches the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface into an interactive always-on-top Document Picture-in-Picture window and restores it to the tab.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面一键移入可交互的始终置顶画中画窗口，并可恢复到原浏览器标签页。
summaries.en: Detaches the DeepSeek Harness web interface into an interactive always-on-top Document Picture-in-Picture window and restores it to the browser tab.

capabilities: Injects a browser script into the DeepSeek Harness web UI
